q: West Brom reached the Premier League for the first time in 2002, going up as Division One runners-up. Which manager took them there?
hint: Megson's side finished second behind champions Manchester City, holding off local rivals Wolves in the run-in.

q: On the final day of the 2004-05 season West Brom won 2-0 at The Hawthorns to complete the Great Escape. Who were the visitors that afternoon?
hint: Albion had been bottom of the table at Christmas; beating Portsmouth on 15 May 2005 lifted them out of the drop zone for the first time all season.

q: Who was West Brom's manager for the final-day survival in May 2005?
hint: Robson had taken over from Gary Megson in November 2004 with the club adrift at the bottom, and became the first manager to keep a Premier League side up after being last at Christmas.

q: West Brom's older nickname, the Throstles, comes from a bird long associated with the club. Which bird is a throstle?
hint: Throstle is an old English word for the song thrush, the bird perched on a crossbar in the club's badge.

q: Roy Hodgson left West Brom in May 2012 to take which job?
hint: Hodgson had steadied Albion after arriving in February 2011, and the FA appointed him England manager ahead of Euro 2012; Steve Clarke replaced him at The Hawthorns.

q: West Brom signed defender Jonny Evans in the summer of 2015 from which club?
hint: The Northern Ireland centre-back ended a nine-year stay at Old Trafford in a deal worth an initial £6m, and went on to captain Albion.

q: West Brom lost the 2007 Championship play-off final at Wembley. Which club beat them 1-0?
hint: Stephen Pearson's second-half finish won it for Derby, a fortnight after Albion had knocked Wolves out in the semi-finals.

q: West Brom won the Championship title in 2007-08 to return to the Premier League. Who was their manager?
hint: Mowbray arrived in October 2006 and built a passing side that won the title and reached an FA Cup semi-final in the same season.

q: After relegation in 2009, which manager took West Brom straight back up as Championship runners-up in 2010?
hint: Di Matteo's first job in England ended in promotion behind champions Newcastle; he was sacked the following February despite it.

q: Steve Clarke's first season in charge, 2012-13, ended with West Brom in which Premier League position?
hint: Eighth on a club-record 49 points remains Albion's best Premier League finish, and their highest league placing since 1985.

q: West Brom drew 5-5 with Manchester United in Sir Alex Ferguson's final match in May 2013. Which Albion striker scored a second-half hat-trick?
hint: Lukaku, on loan from Chelsea, came on at half-time with Albion 3-0 down and scored three as they hit back from 5-2 to 5-5.

q: Peter Odemwingie joined West Brom in August 2010 from which club?
hint: The Nigeria forward arrived from Lokomotiv for a reported £2.5m and scored 15 league goals in his first season back in England.

q: Saido Berahino finally left West Brom in January 2017. Which club signed him?
hint: Spurs had bids rejected in 2015, after which Berahino refused to play; eighteen months later Stoke paid an initial £12m to take him.

q: Which manager took charge of West Brom in January 2015 and later led them to a 10th-place finish in 2016-17?
hint: Pulis replaced Alan Irvine mid-season and delivered 45 points in 2016-17, only Albion's second top-half Premier League finish.

q: Kevin Phillips spent two seasons at The Hawthorns from 2006, ending with promotion as Championship champions. Which Midlands club did West Brom sign him from?
hint: The former Sunderland and Southampton striker had spent a single season at Villa Park before dropping to the Championship with Albion in 2006.

q: West Brom won the 1993 Second Division play-off final 3-0 against Port Vale at Wembley. Which manager led them that day?
hint: Ardiles lasted only one season at The Hawthorns but ended it with promotion in front of a Wembley crowd four-fifths dressed in blue and white.

q: Which substitute opened the scoring in West Brom's 2-0 final-day win that sealed survival in May 2005?
hint: Horsfield came off the bench and volleyed in just before the hour; Kieran Richardson added the second with a quarter of an hour left.

q: On deadline day in January 2013, Peter Odemwingie drove to London and was filmed sitting in his car outside which club's ground?
hint: No fee had been agreed, so Odemwingie was turned away at Loftus Road and was back training with Albion the next day.

q: Which Spanish coach was in charge of West Brom for four months in 2014?
hint: Mel arrived from Real Betis in January 2014, won three of 17 games but kept Albion up in 17th, and left by mutual consent in May.

q: Youssouf Mulumbu arrived at West Brom in 2009 from which club?
hint: The DR Congo midfielder came from PSG, first on loan and then permanently for around £175,000, and became one of Albion's best-value signings of the era.
